title: Measuring in-context algorithmic reasoning in language models against an exact Bayes-optimal reference
abstract: arXiv:2608.01575v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Whether large language models perform algorithmic inference or pattern completion is hard to test, because most benchmarks supply answers but no distributional reference for what the shown evidence licenses. F-ICL supplies one exactly: we exhaustively enumerate the 86 million valid programs of length at most 13 on a Turing-complete machine F, complement-symmetrised to remove output-polarity bias, and compute the exact posterior under a declared bounded Levin--Solomonoff prior. It is Bayes-optimal for that stated prior rather than universal, and models are never told it exists, so the score reads the inductive prior their served distribution already encodes. Across 105 serving configurations spanning open models from 0.8B to 675B and frontier systems, models answer up to 92% of queries correctly, yet 45 of the 46 exposing distributions sit farther from the F reference than a keystroke reference. translated_title: 在语言模型中，针对精确贝叶斯最优参考测量上下文算法推理能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.01575v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：大型语言模型是执行算法推理还是模式补全，这一直难以测试，因为大多数基准测试提供答案，但没有为所展示证据所允许的内容提供分布参考。F-ICL精确提供了这一点：我们穷举枚举了图灵完备机器F上长度至多13的8600万个有效程序，通过互补对称化去除输出极性偏差，并在声明的有界Levin–Solomonoff先验下计算精确后验。该先验对于所声明先验是贝叶斯最优的，而非通用的，且模型从未被告知其存在，因此得分反映了其服务分布已编码的归纳先验。在跨越0.8B到675B开放模型及前沿系统的105种服务配置中，模型正确回答了高达92%的查询，然而46个暴露分布中有45个比按键参考更远离F参考。这不是任务特定伪影的结果。
tldr: 本文提出F-ICL基准，通过精确枚举和贝叶斯最优参考，发现大型语言模型虽能高比例正确回答查询，但其分布与算法推理参考显著偏离，表明其行为更接近模式补全而非真正算法推理。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces F-ICL, a benchmark with an exact Bayes-optimal reference, revealing that large language models answer queries accurately but their distributions deviate significantly from algorithmic inference, suggesting pattern completion rather than true algorithmic reasoning.
